comparison.objective: PR-1871 scribes a shelf profile from an out-of-flat wall; the candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1871 tests holding a workpiece while tracing a continuous contour with a compass, not threaded adjustment and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1871 scores line continuity and profile accuracy followed by tool release; the candidate scores angular setting, nut retention, drift, and repeated actuation.
comparison.reason: Continuous profile transfer is a different tested ability from locking a calibrated mechanical stop.
